items.text: You can now run a workspace on a remote machine. Add a remote server in Settings, pick it as the "Where" target on workspace creation, or re-bind an existing workspace from the inspector.
Agent chats survive reconnects. A network blip, daemon restart, or app restart now replays in-flight chat state from the daemon's journal so chat threads aren't lost to a dropped connection.
New diagnostics surface per-server transport state, last-roundtrip latency, install state, and tailed daemon logs. A reconnect banner appears in-app when a remote disconnects.
